evidence: Shared state: tests/test.sh:104-113 starts ONE app process/DB; run_suite gates (l.213) then scored (l.224) all hit it, so render+constraints always precede scored dimensions, and functional/polish/visual run in an order the task does not control (rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1). Wording is order-agnostic: (1) app_context.md:27-31 'Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count.' and injected into every prompt. (2) functional/prompt.md:15 'Earlier reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages. Use your own new jobs and cards ... never move another review's records, and never rely on starting counts.'; T fallback (l.39) 'counts read relative to their values before you act'; U Mei count computed 'from the sequence you observed' (l.41). (3) polish/prompt.md:14 'never rely on another review's records' and 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own.' (4) visual/prompt.md:14 read-only after its gate ('Do not move cards or send messages'). The only absolute seed expectations are functional Z (prompt l.25; judge.toml hro_unread_counts l.344 'Lena Fischer starts with 1 unread'; hro_restart l.416 seeded Platform Engineer order Greta/Ade/Marco, Priya/Samuel and Noor's note). I verified each is protected from every other dimension: seed reads USR-CAN3/APP-301 read_count 2 of 3 messages (last by USR-REC3) => 1 unread; Lena's state changes only if someone posts in APP-301 or Lena opens it; render gate (prompt l.9) opens no conversation; constraints gate (l.9) 'Do not move, reject or message anything' and uses unique emails; polish/prompt.md:16 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation' and its board rows use 'your cards'/'the same job' (own job); visual sends/moves nothing and its candidate view is Noor. No dimension other than functional moves Platform Engineer cards or edits APP-101 notes. Polish's mutations of Noor's APP-101 conversation (Noor sends, Rafael opens) are tolerated by functional rows l.326/335/353, which grade 'most recent 30', '30 at a time ... until none remain' and unread before/after relative to observed state, with app_context explicitly saying 120 is the start value only. Functional's mutations (J1/J2/Tomas conversations, Rafael drafts, rejections, Activity) cannot disturb polish (own job, clears pre-existing drafts) or visual (craft only; 'a seeded job is fine'). Functional's single restart_app (D, last) only matters to later dimensions if the app cannot restart, which is a real persistence/startup failure rather than a pristine-seed assumption. Gates create only their own suffixed job+card, which no later criterion counts. Counterexamples tried: (a) broken app that reseeds on every start: later dimensions do not reuse earlier records, so it is not over-credited there and hro_restart catches it; (b) conforming app run in order polish->visual->functional: Lena still 1, Platform Engineer order/note untouched, Noor's paging/unread rows graded relative => no false failure found. Minor P3 observation (not a defect): functional T draft legs (prompt l.39, judge l.380) lack polish's 'clear pre-existing draft' instruction, so if polish ran first and left Rafael's session_resume draft in the conversation the functional judge picks as 'another conversation', the typed text would append to it; that conversation still keeps its own different draft, so hro_msg_drafts is not falsified. Limit: no full configured sequential judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent'), so actual judge compliance with these instructions across dimension order is NOT EXERCISED; this row is decided by wording per quality-checks.md:154 and is not a measured reward claim.
